text:
ashley: Quick check — customer 'Northbridge' goes private tomorrow morning. I want a one-line status on the Day-0 blockers (networking, air-gap package, certs, install perms). Can owners call out anything new?

mike: Networking: waiting on customer to confirm egress CIDR. They sent 10.10.0.0/22 but their infra team asked for 10.10.4.0/22 last night. Pushed for final by EOD PST.

sophie: Air-gap: image build finished. Need remote checksum confirmation from customer because download will be via portable media. Also need list of allowed external checksums for our deploy-bot to validate.

raj: Certs: CSR signed, but we need the SAN list updated to include internal hostnames: rbw-vpc-01.northbridge.local and rbw-admin.northbridge.local. Asked security for an updated cert; ETA 3h.

tal: Install perms: customer IAM role not yet confirmed. They promised cross-account role name. Without that we can't run the bootstrap script. I left a message in their ticket.

ashley: Thanks. Two small asks — (1) can someone post the minimal firewall rules we expect so ops can compare to their ACLs? (2) any manual steps in the runbook that are time-sensitive?

raj: Firewall minimal: allow outbound TCP 443 to our control-plane IPs 34.82.120.11, 34.82.120.12 and allow outbound TCP 5233 to metrics.redwood-internal.com (34.82.121.9). Inbound only SSH from their admin jump host 10.10.50.5. I'll paste exact iptables snippet now:

raj: ```
# minimal egress
-A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 34.82.120.11 --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 34.82.120.12 --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 34.82.121.9 --dport 5233 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
# allow admin ssh
-A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.10.50.5 --dport 22 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
```

mike: Adding: if they are behind a strict proxy, we need the proxy CA to be installed in the image or set via runbook env var REDWOOD_PROXY_CA. Otherwise TLS handshake to control plane will fail.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist: image-signed=true, cert-csr=submitted, firewall-confirmed=false, role-confirmed=false

ashley: Good flag from mike. Sophie, can you add a one-liner to the image README on how to inject the proxy CA (if needed)?

sophie: Yep — will add. Also adding checksum instructions for the media validation step.

mike: Customer PO/payment confirmed? Finance ok with starting?

tal: Finance confirm pending signed SOW — legal says we can start staging but not ship images until SOW executed.

ashley: Ok — practical plan for tomorrow morning: (a) raj will push firewall snippet to the runbook and ping customer ops for ACL check (owner: raj), (b) mike will follow up on egress CIDR and proxy CA (owner: mike), (c) sophie will update image README + checksum docs and pre-generate verification commands (owner: sophie), (d) tal will escalate SOW to legal and confirm go/no-go by 09:30 PT (owner: tal). If any of these miss the 09:30 PT window we delay network cutover.

mike: I'll call their infra lead at 07:30 PT and report back.

raj: Pushed runbook change to PR #412, requesting review from @ashley and @mike.

ashley: Reviewing now. If all looks good I'll sign off and trigger the on-prem checklist.

deploy-bot: action: canary-deploy scheduled at 2026-03-18T15:00:00Z upon manual trigger.

ashley: Final: tagging this thread — if you update infra-bot status please include a one-line note so I can forward to the customer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
